toxicities: 相对于剂量而言毒性极低。
effectsSummary: Low doses have a stimulating and strengthening effect. Medium doses: visual hallucinations, distortion of objects in space, altered emotional state. High doses: ego dissolution, strong visual hallucinations.
dosageRemark:
Average dosages of dried* mushrooms:
Pointed cone bald: light 0.1-0.5g, common 0.5-1.5g, strong 1.5-3g, heavy 3g+
Mexican: light 0.3-0.8g, common 0.8-2g, strong 2-3.5g, heavy 3.5g+
generalRisks: The pupils dilate, pulse and blood pressure change, increase in body temperature, nausea, dizziness, and rarely, panic attacks.
saferUse: Consume mushrooms only in good mental and physical condition.
Do not consume mushrooms alone, but with people you trust.
Pay attention to the setting. A stress-free environment is important.
Consume mushrooms only after a light meal, not on an empty stomach and not with a full stomach.
Use dried mushrooms if possible; wash raw mushrooms thoroughly.
In delicate moments during the trip: let go and do not fight the effects.
Avoid mixed consumption, never consume mushrooms together with other drugs.
Avoid roads and other "dangerous" places while under the influence.
In case of panic attacks or horror trips: stay calm, remind yourself it will pass.
After the trip, allow yourself plenty of time to rest and process.
